releaseNotes: v5.2.0 — Voice notes now hear properly (Whisper base model, auto language, no more repetition loops, mic level bar); Indicator tab imports Screenshot, PDF, Excel, CSV and Word; Quick Add live price sits in the middle of the box, big and calm; Dashboard fixed so nothing overflows; NEW Missed & Failed tab — trades you saw but did not take, kept separate so they never touch your P&L or win rate. NEW: Mac app (Apple Silicon + Intel, same code as Windows, updates itself with a Mac helper) and a proper phone version (Quick Add, Trades, Dashboard, Missed — data stays on the phone). Windows updater unchanged (v5.1.11 helper).
